grid = [[8]*12 for _ in range(12)]
grid[0][11]=6
for r in range(2,6): grid[r][11]=1
grid[7][4:6]=[1,1]
grid[8][4:7]=[1,1,1]
grid[9][4:7]=[1,1,1]
grid[9][9:12]=[1,1,1]
grid[10]=[1]*12
grid[11][9:12]=[1,1,1]
out=[]
for r in range(12):
    row=[]
    for c in range(12):
        v=grid[r][c]
        if v in (1,6): row.append(v); continue
        edge = r==0 or r==11 or c==0 or c==11
        near1=any(0<=rr<12 and 0<=cc<12 and grid[rr][cc]==1 for rr in range(max(0,r-1),min(12,r+2)) for cc in range(max(0,c-1),min(12,c+2)))
        row.append(7 if edge or near1 else 8)
    out.append(row)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
